```{r}
library(readr)
Cell<-read_csv("Cell_Inhibition_Schoenfeld.csv")
```

```{r}
summary(Cell)
```

```{r}
names(Cell)
```

```{r}
names(Cell)[3]<-"Cell.Line"
```

```{r}
names(Cell)[5]<-"Replicate.Number"
```

```{r}
names(Cell)[6]<-"Concentration.uM"
```

```{r}
Cell$Concentration<-factor(Cell$`Concentration.uM`)
```

```{r}
##Assignment 4: Perform model selection on the Cell_Inhibition_Schoenfeld.csv dataset. Investigate the relative importance of Inhibitor, Cell Line, VHL status, and Concentration of Inhibitor on Percent Survival.
```

```{r}
#Model at least 10 different combinations of those four predictors. At least one model must have an interaction
```

```{r}
model1<-lm(Cell$PercentSurvival~Cell$Inhibitor)
```

```{r}
summary(model1)
```

```{r}
model2<-lm(Cell$PercentSurvival~Cell$Cell.Line)
```

```{r}
summary(model2)
```

```{r}
model3<-lm(Cell$PercentSurvival~Cell$VHL)
```

```{r}
summary(model3)
```

```{r}
model4<-lm(Cell$PercentSurvival~Cell$Concentration)
```

```{r}
summary(model4)
```

```{r}
model5<-lm(Cell$PercentSurvival~Cell$Inhibitor*Cell$Cell.Line)
```

```{r}
summary(model5)
```

```{r}
model6<-lm(Cell$PercentSurvival~Cell$VHL*Cell$Cell.Line)
```

```{r}
summary(model6)
```

```{r}
model7<-lm(Cell$PercentSurvival~Cell$Inhibitor*Cell$Concentration)
```

```{r}
summary(model7)
```

```{r}
model8<-lm(Cell$PercentSurvival~Cell$Inhibitor*Cell$Concentration*Cell$Cell.Line)
```

```{r}
summary(model8)
```

```{r}
model9<-lm(Cell$PercentSurvival~Cell$Concentration*Cell$VHL)
```

```{r}
summary(model9)
```

```{r}
model10<-lm(Cell$PercentSurvival~Cell$Inhibitor+Cell$Cell.Line+Cell$VHL+Cell$Concentration*Cell$Inhibitor*Cell$Cell.Line*Cell$VHL*Cell$Concentration)
```

```{r}
summary(model10)
```
```{r}
#Modeling intercept
```

```{r}
Cellintercept<-lm(formula = PercentSurvival ~ 1, data= Cell)
```

```{r}
summary(Cellintercept)
```

```{r}
##Describe your justification of why you chose those models. Did you start with the full model and work your way down? Did you start with univariate models and add predictors?
```

```{r}
#I chose to begin with univariate models, and then added predictors/interactions. I added interactions randomly, and then went back and changed the formula for a couple of them after my delta outputs were higher than I wanted. 
```

```{r}
#Which model(s) explained the data the best?
```

```{r}
#Model 10 had the lowest aicc with 3851.73, leading me to believe it is the best overall model choice. AICc(model8)-AICc(model10) had the lowest delta output (4.613812).
```

```{r}
mod10aov<-aov(model10)
```

```{r}
summary(mod10aov)
```
```{r}
mod8aov<-aov(model8)
```

```{r}
summary(mod8aov)
```

```{r}
##Take a summary of the best model(s) and describe which features are significant.
```

```{r}
#Models 10 summary provided an adjusted R-squared value of 0.5635 and a p value of 2.2e-16, and model 8 summary provided an adjusted R-squared value of 0.5418 and a p value of 2.2e-16. ANOVA output for model 10 showed a very high significance for Inhibitor, Concentration, and Inhibitor:VHl, it also had 4 other statistically significant outputs. For model 8, ANOVA output showed a significance for all predictors in the model ranging from very high (Pr=<2e-16) to just under 0.05. This being stated, I think model 10 is the superior choice.
```
